simple.meaning: שַׁלּוּן (Shallûwn) appears once in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Nehemiah, beginning at Nehemiah 3:15. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שַׁלּוּן (H7968) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows שַׁלּוּן through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: שַׁלּוּן (Shallûwn) / H7968 is tracked through Nehemiah 3:15. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of the district of Mizpah repaired the spring gate.
